name: ember
description: Ember — TanStack Start / NestJS / Kotlin Multiplatform boilerplate

scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,yellow,cyan "bun run --cwd packages/contracts dev" "bun run --cwd apps/api start:dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/api test:e2e && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
